topic.title: Build to Rent / Affordable Private Rent / Operations
topic.source_contract: scheme definition, single ownership and management, rental covenant, affordable private rent, nominations, tenancy terms, viability, planning obligation, construction, mobilisation, letting and operational performance evidence

scope_guards: A private-rented proposal is not automatically a Build to Rent scheme.
An operator expression of interest is not treated as secured management.
A viability appraisal is not treated as an agreed affordable housing position.
A planning policy requirement is not treated as an executed covenant.
Planning permission is not treated as completed rental homes.
Practical completion is not treated as occupied and stabilised operation.
Initial lettings are not treated as long-term covenant compliance.
No score or promotion is written without exact consent, covenant, construction, management, lettings and operational evidence.
